neighbours.label: The digit '1' as the third digit of a number that starts 21 or 23 (211, 2114, 0211, 231), as in phone extensions, ISBNs and unicode escapes.
fire: For road conditions dial 211 or 2113 from any phone.
Reach the help desk at extension 2114 or 2117.
Contact the registrar at 231.555.0142 for forms.
The entity '\u2112' maps to a script letter and '\u2113' to another.
quiet: For road conditions dial 911 or 611 from any phone.
Reach the help desk at extension 4127 or 3158.
Contact the registrar at 213.555.0142 for forms.
The entity '\u2012' maps to a dash and '\u2013' to another.

notes: Card: 26 of the top 32 peaks are '1', all after 21 or 23. Probe: 211/2114 scored 1.0 and ISBN 0-231 0.65, but 611, 911, 111, 121 and 221 scored about 0; 231 in plain prose only 0.28, so the context matters too.
